2026-09-28 15:57:01.911986 | controller |
2026-09-28 15:57:01.911995 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 15:57:01.913687 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 15:57:01.913703 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 15:57:01.913707 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 15:57:01.913711 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-28 15:57:01.913714 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
